name: Jishu Sumaro
source:
Tech is your average fun loving gamer bro. Endlessly enthusiastic and endlessly energetic, Tech runs his virtual reality cafe, Techy Games, in Las Vegas. Despite gaming cafes falling out of prominence, Tech manages his as a labor of love. Whether it's talking your ear off about the current games, or working out to maintain his washboard abs, Tech does everything at one hundred percent. He'd love to show you around, as long as you're not garbage at shooters.

[From Kickstarter]
